adsReplies.title: Screen the matter
adsReplies.description: The AI collects what your intake team needs: matter type, key dates, and names for conflict checks. It flags urgent matters like arrests and deadlines. It never gives legal advice.

smsBooking.title: Book the consultation

checklist: Callback request if no slot fits

items.q: What does Boltcall do for a law firm?
items.a: Boltcall answers new inquiries by phone, text, and web form within seconds, 24/7. It screens the matter, flags urgent ones, and books a consultation on your calendar. Your team gets a summary of every inquiry.
No. It handles intake only. It does not assess a case, quote fees, or tell a caller what their rights are. If asked, it explains that an attorney will follow up.

items.q: Does the caller know it is an AI?
items.a: Yes. Every call opens by saying the caller is speaking with an AI assistant and that the call is recorded. That disclosure cannot be switched off.

items.q: What happens with an urgent matter?
items.a: Arrests, custody emergencies, and deadline-driven matters are flagged as urgent and your team is alerted right away. You can also set rules to transfer calls to a person. If no one picks up, it takes a message and requests a callback.

items.q: Can I keep my current phone number?
items.a: Yes. You can forward your existing number to Boltcall, or get a new local number in the app.
About 5 minutes to start. Enter your firm details, pick a voice, and your AI intake assistant is live. Connect a calendar so it can book consultations.

items.q: Does it connect to my calendar or case management software?
items.a: Boltcall books into Google Calendar and Cal.com. It can send new matters to other tools through Zapier, Make, or webhooks. There is no native Clio or MyCase connection yet.
